title: Resources for Situational Awareness in Humanitarian Emergencies
html:
Can you count the number of times someone has mentioned Situational Awareness as a glorious end-state that will answer all questions? Over the past few years, I have lost count. And, what became abundantly clear when quizzing people is that no one seemed to agree on what Situational Awareness meant, who would become situational aware, how it could be achieved, and what resources & information were needed or available.

Recognizing that I would likely not contribute much to finding an agreed definition of situational awareness in a consensus-driven environment, I figured that putting together a list of information, tools and services may be a tangible output that could help most anyone no matter their definition of situational awareness.

So, mid last year, I collaborated with RJ Reid to see if we could build such a list. But, as you might expect, even searching for such items required that we put a framework and a definition of situational awareness in place in order to give us structured direction. RJ turned to Mica Endsley to help come up with a definition. Why not go to one of the leading experts on the topic?

Although the resulting report provides a general definition and puts in place other framework aspects, the major benefit is a very detailed list and matrix of all the various information, tools and services we found that could help you no matter your definition of Situation Awareness.

The final report, with the complete list, is titled, rather obviously, Resources for Situational Awareness in Humanitarian Emergencies - An Overview of Sources of Information, Tools and Services.

Download PDF report

We hope that you find the compiled list beneficial in a variety of ways. But, most importantly, we hope that it helps moves people from theory to action just a little bit faster.

Andrej
teaser: An overview of sources, tools and services for situational awareness in emergencies, compiled with RJ Reid.
seo_description: A resource list and report on situational awareness in humanitarian emergencies, with a definition from Mica Endsley.
